content.short: Bounty Bay is a Web3 social shopping marketplace on TON that rewards users for group buying.
content.description: Bounty Bay is an innovative Web3 social shopping marketplace built on the TON blockchain and integrated directly into Telegram. It allows users to 'team up' with friends to unlock exclusive discounts and earn on-chain rewards in $BBY tokens for their shopping activity and social referrals. Backed by the TON Foundation, Bounty Bay leverages social mechanics to create a more rewarding and interactive e-commerce experience. It represents a significant step in the evolution of SocialFi, bringing the benefits of decentralized finance to the everyday world of online shopping.
content.meta: Shop and earn with your friends on Bounty Bay. Social shopping on TON via Lancers Web3 Explorer.
